sloka: तद्बभूवाद्भुतं युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ।रामस्य च महाबाहो रावणस्य च रक्षसः ।। ६.१०३.१५ ।।
transliteration: tadbabhūvādbhutaṁ yuddhaṁ tumulaṁ romaharṣaṇam ।rāmasya ca mahābāho rāvaṇasya ca rakṣasaḥ ।। 6.103.15 ।।

translations.english: "To you, Kakuthsa, who are endowed with great prowess, destroyer of enemies, this chariot has been sent by Indra for your victory."
